organization.name: Green Turtle Trades
organization.description: Green Turtle Trades Limited is an Edinburgh company developing an alternative investment platform for UK professional clients and copy trading technology for independent traders. GTT reviews trading records, filters trade instructions and calculates investor allocations for execution at its designated broker. Investment management is intended to sit with the regulated host firm. We are onboarding traders now and welcome discussions with prospective UK professional clients. The investment platform is in development and is not yet available.

website.name: Green Turtle Trades
website.description: An Edinburgh-based alternative investment platform in development for UK professional clients, with trader verification and MT4/MT5 copy trading technology. GTT is onboarding traders and welcoming professional client discussions; the investment platform is not yet available. Analytics and the virtual university competition are supporting products.

companyProfile.traders: GTT is onboarding independent traders for its proposed copy trading platform. Approved MT4 and MT5 source broker accounts can be retained, subject to permission and compatibility. Records, strategy and risk are reviewed before any copying arrangement. Applying does not guarantee selection, a contract or investor capital.
companyProfile.investors: The proposed alternative investment platform is for UK professional clients only. GTT welcomes prospective client discussions, but the investment platform is not yet available. GTT provides verification, trade filtering, allocation calculations and reporting; client capital and execution sit with the designated broker, with investment management intended to sit with the regulated host firm. An enquiry does not establish eligibility.
